title: Nightly web bug fixes: lobby poll banner and origin cargo
description: Two visible fixes from the 2026-10-08 sweep. (A) A failed background lobby poll no longer becomes a fixed, undismissable red banner over the bottom controls: one dropped poll is silent, three in a row show a small chip at the top right, the next success removes it, and a failed action keeps its banner but with a Dismiss button. (B) The tactical movement planner no longer offers fighters and ground forces from an origin that holds the player's own command token (rule 95.5, Dominus Orb); the engine refused them. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server; regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BG. The third fix (auto-play race, quiet 409) has no visible layout.

shots.heading: Three failed polls in a row
shots.caption: A small 'Connection lost. Retrying' chip at the top right. It ignores pointer input and never covers the bottom controls (before: a full-width banner 'TypeError: Failed to fetch Check the lobby and try again.' pinned to the bottom).

shots.heading: After the next successful poll
shots.caption: The chip is gone without any click (before: the banner stayed forever).

shots.heading: A failed action
shots.caption: Ready was refused (409): the banner stays, shows the server's reason and has a Dismiss button.

shots.heading: Origin without a command token
shots.caption: Control: the fighter at the origin is offered as cargo.

shots.heading: Origin with the player's own command token
shots.caption: No fighter or infantry rows: the engine would refuse the load (95.5) unless the origin is the active system.
